description: Bundle contract; metadata is descriptive and never re-encodes committed revision files.

sender.apk_sha256: Android actual installed base.apk SHA-256; absent on macos
sender.program_sha256: macOS actual executing owner executable SHA-256; absent on android
sender.sdk_dso_sha256: actual loaded unique SDK shared library bytes SHA-256
sender.parser_version: actual native writer tag, exreader-sdk-3.41.0 on Android / 3.41.0 on macOS

reading_records.revision_id: actual selected committed reading revision id

rules: All files are safe relative bundle paths; no absolute path, traversal, symlink or duplicate file.
All originals and every complete ancestor, including actual book entity wire, must be included.
Revision files are exact bytes returned from public retained APIs; no JSON canonicalization or parser substitution.
Integers inside capture.numbers are decimal strings; capture.selectors preserve null versus empty base64.
Capture reflects the real stored decoded G03 location, not a reauthored receiver oracle.
Receiver uses public receive on every original revision byte then real typed reading decode and SDK resolve.
Android incoming without a real macOS sender bundle remains pending; protocol fixtures cannot grant interoperability.
